notes: My pass: one QR code for every meal, coupon, check-in and ride at your conference. It shows even without internet.
See what your pass holds: your meals and coupons, and which ones you've already used.
Scan passes: organizers, and staff they allow, scan passes with the camera. Each meal or coupon can only be handed out once.
Meals: choose who gets each one and how many times.
Pro events: coupons such as welcome kits, gifts and drinks, daily check-in, bus boarding, QR codes on ID cards, and a list of who has what.
The verified badge now goes to organizers of a Pro event, and the app shows a notice during maintenance.
Organize from your phone: create and edit events with a map pin, publish them, and see what needs you.
Allocation: review applications, place delegates in a committee and country, and manage the countries per committee.
Set up committees, details, marking, partners, staff, the schedule, announcements and the rules.
Modules and tools: meals, transport, rooms, dress code, complaints, results, certificates, ID cards and your event's colour.
Financials: tickets with early-bird and late prices, the application schedule, your event's money and your wallet with payouts.
Pro is now per event: upgrade one event for live video, no caps and more, or ask the MUN Pilot team.
Image uploads now need you to be signed in.
Conferences: your conferences and Browse with filters, a portal home for each conference, your team, and payments with receipts.
Documents in one place: your position paper, the study guide, committee papers and the rules.
Help desk: send a request to your chair, follow it, and request a committee or country move.
Meals, transport, results and your certificate, with real QR codes for coupons and boarding.
Chair hub: mark the day, see the motion log, grade position papers and keep private notes.
Chairs can answer requests, write and publish the study guide, publish standings, send awards and post room alerts from the phone.
Executive Board: oversee your committees and move or remove chairs. Observers get a read-only view.
Settings: notifications, privacy and your account in the app.
New tabs: Home, Conferences, Messages, Network and Profile.
Home shows your stats, the conference to continue, recommended conferences and recent activity.
Notifications in one place: updates, staff invitations (accept or decline here) and room alerts, which also pop up over any screen.
Network: discover people, connect, disconnect, block and unblock; full public profiles with ratings, endorsements and recommendations.
Messages: chat with anyone and in groups, see who's online and when your message was read, search in a chat, and find your committee chat, dais threads and announcements in one list.
Blogs: read the delegate handbook, join the discussion, and write your own posts with AI help on the text you select.
Edit your whole profile from the app: photo, cover, intro, experience, education, awards, skills and account details.
Your email and phone are now private: choose whether everyone or only your connections can see them.
Faster and lighter: what you've loaded is kept on the phone and refreshed only when needed. Pull down to refresh.
In-app updates: the app checks for a new version every 15 minutes, notifies you, and installs it from Settings.
What's New in Settings lists every change, version by version.
Conference alerts (allocations, migrations, endorsements) now arrive as phone notifications, not only in the app.
Settings shows when notifications are off and takes you straight to turn them on.
Smaller download: one APK per phone type.
MUN Pilot redesign: new look, new name and icon.
Messages tab with dais threads from each sitting.
Sign in or sign up with Google; connect Google from Settings.
Edit your profile from the app.
Vector country flags everywhere.
Chair session menu, console light and dark, room board and ceremony layouts.
